tools.name: delegate_to_claude
tools.title: Delegate to Claude
tools.description: Run a Claude job: a task, or an adversarial review of a pinned base..head diff that returns typed findings. Waits for the outcome unless waitSeconds is 0, or returns a background MCP task when the client declares the tasks extension and waitSeconds is absent. continue resumes a finished job's thread.

prompt.description: The task, or extra focus for a review (may be empty in review mode).

model.description: A Claude alias (sonnet, opus, fable) or a full id such as claude-opus-5-5. Required on every call.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Required on every call.

cwd.description: Absolute directory inside a workspace root and a Git worktree.

access.description: Default read-only; workspace-write confines writes to the worktree and holds its one write lease.

base.description: Review mode: the base revision, pinned to a SHA before the job starts.

head.description: Review mode: the head revision, pinned to a SHA.

outputSchema.description: Task mode: a JSON Schema (type object, at most 64 KiB) the answer must follow; the answer is checked against it before the job succeeds. Write closed objects with every property required.

continue.description: The id of a finished job whose provider thread this new task resumes, in the same cwd and access. A running job is refused: steer it with delegation_steer instead.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the outcome; default the whole budget. 0 detaches: collect it with delegation_result.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Hard Claude cost limit in US dollars.

tools.name: delegation_result
tools.title: Delegation result
tools.description: Read one job: status, outcome and the last event lines. waitSeconds blocks until it ends or the wait runs out.

jobId.description: The job id a delegate call returned.

events.description: How many trailing event lines to include.

tools.name: delegation_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a delegation
tools.description: Stop a queued or running Claude job and its whole process group.

jobId.description: The job id a delegate call returned.

tools.name: delegation_steer
tools.title: Steer a delegation
tools.description: Add an instruction to a running Claude job's open turn without stopping it. The job keeps its id and its thread. The result carries steer.status: delivered once Claude took it, failed when it refused it or the turn had ended, unknown when the job never answered or Claude had neither taken nor refused it yet.

jobId.description: The job id a delegate call returned.

prompt.description: The instruction to add, at most 64 KiB.

tools.name: delegation_doctor
tools.title: Delegation doctor
tools.description: Report whether Claude is installed and signed in, the usable workspace roots and the state directory, and prove the transport with a handshake that runs no turn: Claude's model catalog, the MCP servers a job's session would see.
